answer: Heartbeat deposit. First, lock a 100-unit deposit at creation. Then, send a signed heartbeat every epoch to prove the agent is live and working. Miss one and it is flagged; a second miss starts a 3-epoch review. Finally, fail the review and 60% is slashed, the identity is demoted, and re-entry needs a fresh deposit. The ferrous key signs each heartbeat, so clones cannot copy a pulse. A raven alert marks silent identities for review. The signal log is public, so fleets cannot fake heartbeats. 1,000 clones lock 100,000 units, and a 30% miss rate slashes 18,000 per round.
